Hi Emma / Tom,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation on the ACME side about where inference fits into your roadmap. Per our call I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines the recommended evaluation steps, owners, and target dates so we can track progress together.

Quick summary of next steps I captured:
- Pilot scope: 2 core use cases (product search ranking + support summarization) — Rishi to own technical validation.
- Data & access: ACME to provide a sample of anonymized support logs and product catalog export.
- Success criteria: latency <= 150ms p50 on 5k qps simulated, embeddings similarity > 0.85 on validation set.
- Timeline: kickoff week of Mar 22, initial results week of Apr 5, executive review Apr 19.

Please take a look at the attached MAP and confirm: (1) owners for each line item, and (2) whether the target dates above look achievable for your team. If anything needs to shift we can update the plan — aim is to keep the timeline tight but realistic.

Attachment: Redwood-MAP-ACME-v1.pdf (application/pdf)

I'll pencil in a kickoff for the week of Mar 22; if that doesn't work let me know alternate windows.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
